snippet.title: OUT NOW! BrushHammer Miniature Painter is officially available on Meta Quest.
snippet.description:
BrushHammer Miniature Painter just launched on Meta Quest. 
Available on Quest 2, 3, 3S, and Pro.

Grab a brush, pick a mini, and start painting. All the fun of the miniature painting hobby, without the mess!
